title: prefill/decode: chunked prefill + speculative prefill + stage overlap scheduling
author: Ariella Chen
description: Motivation: reduce per-request latency and increase throughput for mixed prefill+decode workloads by improving how prefill work is chunked and overlapped with decode, and by adding a speculative prefill path to reduce wait time for critical decode steps. This PR implements three related runtime optimizations: 1) chunked prefill: break long prefill KV/cache work into smaller chunks to allow earlier decode scheduling and reduce tail latency on variable-length prefill requests; 2) speculative prefill: start lightweight speculative KV population and kernel warm-up for likely subsequent decode sequences (configurable confidence thresholds); 3) stage overlap scheduler: scheduling changes that allow prefill and decode stages to overlap safely when resources permit (respecting KV cache coherency and memory bounds). The description below is a single continuous string that includes checklist and rollout notes. Changes include runtime code, kernel scheduler hooks, KV cache sync points, tests, and docs. Checklist: - [x] microbenchmarks (prefill-heavy, mixed, small decode) - [x] unit + integration tests - [x] stress test and memory/regression checks - [x] feature gate + config knobs - [x] docs/notes for ops and rollback Plan: roll out behind feature flag "prefill_stage_overlap_v2" with canary traffic (10%) for 48h, then 50% for 24h, then full ramp if no regressions. Linked: ENG-5183 design doc (internal link), perf dashboard (link omitted).
